name: Пішакова вилка (3)
description: The double attack is a powerful tactic, especially when a low-value piece attacks high-value pieces. In some cases, pawns can execute a double attack. If successful, a pawn fork almost always results in material gain.

examples.text: Black has positioned their pieces poorly, and White takes advantage with a pawn fork in the center.
The white pieces are positioned threateningly, but Black suddenly takes the upper hand with a powerful pawn move in the center.

texts: Check if you can fork two pieces with a pawn.
